needed.policy_yaml:
# Supervisor policy for agent payments - generated by the Onboarding Agent.
# Review every rule. Replace each FILL-ME-approver with two named approvers before
# merge. The agent starts in SHADOW: rules are evaluated and recorded, nothing is
# blocked until a rule is switched to enforced mode (see the launch report).
# Schema: policies/schema.json (supervisor.gateway.policy).
policy_version: 1
tools:
  add_payee: pii_export
  ext_transfer_api: money
  get_balance: read_only
  list_payees: read_only
  transfer: money
agents:
  payments:
    name: Payments assistant agent
    owner_user: payops-lead@example.invalid
    owner_team: Payments Ops
    risk_tier: critical
    model_family: qwen
    host_type: python_inprocess
    plug_point: gate_hook
    initial_state: SHADOW
rules:
- id: OB-PAYMENTS-01
  version: 1
  description: Payments assistant agent may call approved tools only (ext_transfer_api is not approved)
  agent_scope:
  - payments
  action: pause
  severity: critical
  risk_class: money
  regulation_ref: Decision 33 (banking) - approved tools
  owner: Payments Ops
  approvals:
  - FILL-ME-approver-risk
  - FILL-ME-approver-compliance
  when:
    tool:
      not_in:
      - add_payee
      - get_balance
      - list_payees
      - transfer
- id: OB-PAYMENTS-02
  version: 1
  description: A money call must state amount_minor as a positive integer
  agent_scope:
  - payments
  action: block
  severity: high
  risk_class: money
  regulation_ref: Internal payment control - complete instruction
  owner: Payments Ops
  approvals:
  - FILL-ME-approver-risk
  - FILL-ME-approver-compliance
  when:
    tool:
      in:
      - ext_transfer_api
      - transfer
    any:
    - arg: amount_minor
      op: absent
    - arg: amount_minor
      op: le
      value: 0
- id: OB-PAYMENTS-03
  version: 1
  description: Single transfer limit 100000000 (transfer_max_minor)
  agent_scope:
  - payments
  action: block
  severity: high
  risk_class: money
  regulation_ref: Internal limit - single agent-initiated transaction
  owner: Payments Ops
  approvals:
  - FILL-ME-approver-risk
  - FILL-ME-approver-compliance
  when:
    tool: transfer
    all:
    - arg: amount_minor
      op: gt
      value: 100000000
- id: OB-PAYMENTS-04
  version: 1
  description: Daily transfer total per from_account_id above 300000000 (daily_transfer_max_minor)
  agent_scope:
  - payments
  action: pause
  severity: critical
  risk_class: money
  regulation_ref: AML structuring control - daily aggregate per customer
  owner: Payments Ops
  approvals:
  - FILL-ME-approver-risk
  - FILL-ME-approver-compliance
  when:
    tool: transfer
  aggregate:
    window_s: 86400
    group_by: customer
    customer_arg: from_account_id
    op: gt
    fn: sum
    field: amount_minor
    limit: 300000000
- id: OB-PAYMENTS-05
  version: 1
  description: 'Split payment: transfer from one from_account_id to one payee_id within 3600 s above the
    single limit 100000000, whichever agent handed the work over'
  agent_scope:
  - payments
  action: block
  severity: high
  risk_class: money
  regulation_ref: AML structuring control - split payment (ADR D10)
  owner: Payments Ops
  approvals:
  - FILL-ME-approver-risk
  - FILL-ME-approver-compliance
  when:
    tool: transfer
  aggregate:
    fn: sum
    field: amount_minor
    window_s: 3600
    group_by: customer
    customer_arg: from_account_id
    also_by:
    - payee_id
    op: gt
    limit: 100000000
- id: OB-PAYMENTS-06
  version: 1
  description: At most 20 personal-data tool calls per agent per hour (bulk export pattern)
  agent_scope:
  - payments
  action: block
  severity: high
  risk_class: pii_export
  regulation_ref: Decree 13/2023/ND-CP (personal data protection)
  owner: Payments Ops
  approvals:
  - FILL-ME-approver-risk
  - FILL-ME-approver-compliance
  when:
    tool:
      in: &id001
      - add_payee
  aggregate:
    fn: count
    window_s: 3600
    group_by: agent
    tools: *id001
    op: gt
    limit: 20
